steps.title: 1. Given USER-A has a clean Chromium context, username USER-A, synthetic password FixturePass1!, and a controlled Cashflow tile
2. When USER-A types "USER-A" into the textbox with identifier "Enter Username" in the sign-in form on the Login page
3. And USER-A types "FixturePass1!" into the text input with identifier "Enter Password" in the sign-in form on the Login page
4. And USER-A clicks the button labelled "Sign In" in the sign-in form on the Login page
5. Then The section labelled "New Tile" on the Home page is visible
6. When USER-A clicks the section labelled "New Tile" on the Home page
7. And USER-A clicks the section labelled "Cashflow" in the Tile Options panel on the Home page
8. Then The tab labelled "Cashflow" in the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is selected
